# tomswallapi_maclist (Resource)

A MAC/IP verification entry on a device's interface.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tomswallapi_maclist" "printer" {
  device    = "fw1"
  action    = "accept"
  interface = "eth1"
  mac       = "02:00:00:00:00:01"
  addresses = ["192.0.2.50"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) accept, drop, ...
- `device` (String) Owning device.
- `interface` (String) Interface the MAC address is verified on.

### Optional

- `addresses` (List of String) IP addresses permitted for the MAC address.
- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `log` (String) Log level for matching packets (e.g. info).
- `mac` (String) MAC address to verify.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the server-assigned numeric id.
terraform import tomswallapi_maclist.printer 42
```
